detaileddescription.para: One buffer is shared by every sideband transaction, so the transport is not reentrant. A transaction started from the HPD interrupt handler while a main-loop transaction is in flight would overwrite the reassembly in place. SbBusy rejects the nested call instead.

briefdescription.para: Set while a sideband transaction owns SbReply.
Claims the shared sideband reply buffer for one transaction.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the caller owns the buffer, XST_DEVICE_BUSY when a sideband transaction is already in flight.

The test and the set are not atomic, so this is not a formal critical section. It rejects the case that occurs in practice, an HPD interrupt handler starting a transaction while the main loop is inside one.
